# PsyGroup

> PsyGroup — European-wide catalog of psychological events and programs. A platform where organizers create events and visitors discover them and submit applications without registration.

## About the Platform

PsyGroup is a bilingual (Ukrainian/English) catalog platform for discovering psychological events and programs. Organizers publish their programs after moderation, visitors browse the catalog and submit applications without creating an account.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://psygroup.org/ua) — search events with filters
- [Catalog](https://psygroup.org/ua/catalog) — all available psychological events and programs
- [Organizers](https://psygroup.org/ua/organizers) — catalog of verified organizers
- [About](https://psygroup.org/ua/about) — mission and values of the platform
- [FAQ](https://psygroup.org/ua/faq) — frequently asked questions about psychological events
- [Contacts](https://psygroup.org/ua/contacts) — get in touch with the team
- [Privacy Policy](https://psygroup.org/ua/privacy) — GDPR-compliant privacy policy
- [Terms of Use](https://psygroup.org/ua/terms) — platform terms and conditions

## Event Types

The platform supports 17 types of events:

- Therapeutic groups (therapeutic)
- Workshops (workshop)
- Seminars (seminar)
- Lectures (lecture)
- Lecture courses (lecture-course)
- Intensives (intensive)
- Author programs (author-program)
- Supervision (supervision)
- Intervision (intervision)
- Conferences (conference)
- Symposia (symposium)
- Certifications (certification)
- Specializations (specialization)
- Educational programs (educational-programs)
- Modular programs (modular)
- Pilot programs (pilot)
- Other (other)

## Event Formats

- **Online** — meetings via video conferencing
- **Offline** — in-person meetings in cities across Europe (Warsaw, Berlin, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam, and others)
- **Hybrid** — combination of online and offline formats

## How It Works

1. Visitor browses the event catalog with filters by type, format, date, and language
2. Chooses an event and reviews the program details
3. Fills out an application (name, email, phone, answers to organizer questions)
4. Organizer reviews the application and makes a decision
5. Approved participant receives participation details

## Organizer Verification

Every organizer goes through moderation before publishing. The profile includes qualifications, education, specializations, and professional organizations.

## For Organizers

- Registration and profile verification
- Create events with detailed program descriptions
- Manage applications and communicate with participants
- Free listing

## Technical Information

- Languages: Ukrainian (ua), English (en)
- URL structure: `/ua/...` and `/en/...`
- Sitemap: `/sitemap.xml`
- hreflang support for bilingual SEO
- Cookie consent banner for GDPR compliance
- Structured data (JSON-LD) on FAQ page
